paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 146b, where he disagrees with Rav Ashi and is mentioned first.[^1]

notes.text: מדיפתא is retained as of Difta rather than silently normalized to Difti. קמו: gives Shabbat 146b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. “Mentioned first” retains the ambiguity of לראשונה: first in the passage or for the first time; it does not establish an earliest occurrence across a corpus. Both Rav titles are full.
